reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent token-usage analytics, including per-session and per-model summaries, daily heatmaps, a settings page, an API, and optional reasoning-effort configuration synchronization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 Token 用量统计、按会话和模型分析、每日热力图、设置页面及可选的推理强度配置同步。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent token-usage statistics, session and model analytics, daily heatmaps, a settings page, and optional reasoning-effort configuration synchronization.

capabilities: Reads provider-reported token usage and session events
Persists aggregate usage statistics in a local settings namespace
Displays usage summaries, model breakdowns, daily data, and heatmaps
Provides a settings page, API, and /tokens command
Synchronizes configured reasoning-effort fields for supported providers and models
